Emma / Team — I reviewed NordicBank's redlines overnight. High-level notes:

- UK IDTA: the proposed addendum is OK in principle but there are two points to clarify: 1) the liability cap carve-out for data transfers and 2) the termination-trigger definitions tied to export restrictions. I added inline comments in the attached redline doc.
- Subprocessors: Redwood will accept the proposed notification window (30 days) but cannot accept automatic consent for new subprocessors; we propose a reasonable approval/objection process instead.
- SCCs: we'll append the EU SCCs template and include transfer impact summary as an exhibit.

Attached: NordicBank_DPA_redlines_v3.docx (marissa_comments)

Proposal: once Laura confirms the evidence pack is complete, I will incorporate our counter-redline and prepare a DocuSign-ready PDF. Target for counter: Fri 07/03 COB.
